abi.return_value: EAX = the formatting engine result in ESI (characters written); the NUL terminator is written at *ptr unless the counter went negative
abi.stack_cleanup: caller (484 call sites, e.g. 0x00405B85 add esp,0xC after 0x00405B80; 0x00415B6A add esp,8 after 0x00415B65 for Debug_Error)

globals_touched: none; the _iobuf lives on the stack
retail_structure.semantic_summary: Statically linked MSVC CRT sprintf. It builds a stack _iobuf over the destination (count 0x7FFFFFFF, flags 0x42 = _IOWRT|_IOSTRG), calls _output(stream, format, &first_variadic_arg) at 0x004A53DC, decrements the count, writes the NUL terminator at the stream pointer when the result is non-negative, or flushes through _flsbuf when the counter went negative, and returns the _output result.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail 0x004A53B3 is the 82-byte, 4-block/4-edge MSVC CRT sprintf: stack _iobuf (count 0x7FFFFFFF, flags 0x42), _output(stream, format, &arg), NUL termination or _flsbuf on a negative counter. The candidate binding is the toolchain CRT symbol named sprintf at 0x004A25F0; no port-owned body exists.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: C cdecl variadic: [esp+4] char* destination, [esp+8] const char* format, [esp+12] and above the substitutions. Retail builds &arg_10h at 0x004A53C3 and passes it as the third _output argument; the candidate CRT entry has the same C ABI, and 484 retail call sites clean 4/8/0xC+ stack bytes.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: There is no port-owned body to inspect for constants: the candidate calls the toolchain CRT. The retail stack-iobuf constants (0x7FFFFFFF count, 0x42 _IOWRT|_IOSTRG) are recorded in the retail structure, but they are not reproduced by candidate source.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Both write the formatted bytes and the NUL terminator to the caller destination and return the character count. The differential compared the full 512-byte destination and return value on 10 fixtures; no candidate source declares a competing buffer layout.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail calls _output (0x004A7720) and _flsbuf (0x004A760B); the candidate reaches mingw-w64 __mingw_sprintf / __mingw_pformat. The body is entirely CRT-owned, so call-level identity is not claimed. The observable side effects (destination bytes, return value) were compared and passed.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: The return is the formatting count in ESI moved to EAX at 0x004A5400. The negative-counter error path flushes via _flsbuf and then takes the same return; the candidate CRT returns the same count for the bounded fixtures.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No port-owned formatting engine exists to review, and the differential covers integer/string C-locale fixtures only; no floating-point formats were executed.

checks.name: single_candidate_symbol
checks.detail: nm -C over build-clean-win32/igi1.exe finds exactly one definition named sprintf (0x004A25F0) and no igi::retail::error::sprintf symbol. The using ::sprintf name alias emits no symbol.

checks.name: behavioural_differential
checks.detail: format_diff_runner.py: retail VEX execution versus the modeled candidate CRT boundary (__mingw_sprintf), 10/10 cases, return and 512 destination bytes. Emulator/host evidence only.

checks.name: build
checks.detail: The binding translation unit compiles for i686-w64-mingw32 -O3 -DNDEBUG and the clean candidate links the single sprintf symbol.

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail and candidate both expose the C cdecl variadic `int sprintf(char*, const char*, ...)`. Retail implements it inside igi.exe as the MSVC CRT; the candidate links the mingw-w64 CRT, whose `sprintf` symbol exists at 0x004A25F0 and whose formatting calls bind to __mingw_sprintf under the default ANSI-stdio setting. The ABI and observable contract match; the implementation is not address- or instruction-identical and is not claimed to be.

limitations: No paired retail/candidate game-process runtime capture exists for this address. RUNTIME_TESTED and VERIFIED are not claimed.
The candidate has no port-owned sprintf body: it uses the host CRT. The retail _iobuf/_output instruction sequence is not reproduced.

Under the default mingw-w64 ANSI stdio setting the compiled calls bind to __mingw_sprintf (the C99 implementation), while the `sprintf` symbol at 0x004A25F0 is the CRT's non-ANSI entry. Both are CRT-owned; no port-owned symbol exists.
The differential covers bounded integer/string C-locale formats only; floating point, %n, overflow, invalid pointers and CRT failure paths are not covered.
